Step by step

Join your team on Holdsport

Five minutes on your phone. Keep Deng's message open, the link is in there.

← All guides

Holdsport is our team app. Sessions, the calendar, club news and the membership fee all live there. It is in Danish, so here is every tap, with the Danish word next to it.

Joining a team starts your membership fee. Use the link once you have decided to stay. The free first session needs no Holdsport at all.

Before you start

  • The team link from Deng. Every family gets its own link, and it opens your child's team.
  • Your child's full name and date of birth.
  • Your email, mobile number and address.

The steps

  1. 1

    Tap the link from Deng

    It opens Holdsport in your phone's browser, in Danish.

    A cookie box may pop up first. Tap Accepter to go on, or Flere muligheder to choose fewer cookies.

  2. 2

    Check the team name

    The top of the page says Invitation til and then the team, for example Talata Mini (U9).

    Wrong team or wrong child? Stop here and message Deng.

  3. 3

    New profile, or log in

    New to Holdsport? Tap Opret ny profil (create new profile) and go to step 4.

    Already on Holdsport, for a sibling or yourself? Tap Log på (log in) and go to step 5.

  4. 4

    Fill in your child's details

    Name and date of birth are your child's. Email and mobile can be yours.

    Add the address, pick a username and a password you will remember, tick the three boxes for terms and data, and save.

    The mistake most parents make: typing their own name here. The member is the player. You get added as the parent afterwards.

  5. 5

    Logged in? Pick your child

    Logged in already? Pick your child's profile, never your own name. If your child has no profile yet, link a child. If it is already linked to yours, select it.

    Your own name here makes you the member. Picked yourself by mistake? Message Deng and he fixes it.

  6. 6

    Check the team is there

    Your child's profile now shows the Talata team. That is it, your child is in.

    Want to manage it from your own login? Open Profile settings on your child's profile, tap your child's name at the top right, then press Add profile. Press Assign parent to this profile, then Create profile. Enter your details and press the green Create button. Log out of your child's profile and log in with your new one, and you run both from one login.

    Got more than one child? The same link works for each of them.

  7. 7

    Get the app

    Search Holdsport on the App Store or Google Play. Log in with the same username and password.

    Turn on notifications, club news comes through here. Add a photo of your child too, it helps the coaches learn names fast.

What happens next

The membership fee

Joining starts the half-season membership fee. The invoice comes through Holdsport, under Betalinger (payments). Charged twice, or no invoice at all? Tell Deng and he sorts it.

The training calendar

Sessions sit under Aktiviteter in the app. Tap Tilmeld when your child is coming and Afmeld when they are not. The coaches plan each session on those numbers.

More Holdsport words in English: the Holdsport guide.

Stuck?

Reply to Deng's message, or WhatsApp him. Send a screenshot of where you are and he takes it from there.

WhatsApp Deng

Rather skip all this? Reply yes to his message and Deng adds your child to the team himself.
